dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: Hello there, distinguished guests of Lady Yae and the Almighty Shogun.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Eh? Have you seriously forgotten who I am?

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: I'm Yae Publishing House's planner, the de facto organizer of the "This Novel Is Amazing!" event. We've met before.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon... kinda remembers...

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: That's alright, I'm sure you'll remember me after this encounter.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: After all, with this new experience, I'll be able to inject some incredible, never-before-seen creativity into Yae Publishing House's next event! I'll become a renowned planner... Ahh, I truly am spectacular!

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Right, the plan is to visit as many famous spots as possible.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: I hear there are quite a few scenic places inhabited by all sorts of fantastic animals here in Sumeru, where inquisitive researchers and noble Forest Rangers alike come and go, along with those mysterious, dangerous, yet alluring mercenaries.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Writers should be able to find inspiration around every corner here.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: I recommended that Lady Yae bring more writers here to gather materials for their work, but she replied, "Quality is far more important than quantity," and selected Souka at random after flipping through the list.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: In truth, Souka hasn't published any successful pieces yet. But I added her to our backup roster because of her great writing skills and her ability to quickly become immersed in stories.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... so that's how Souka was selected... It does feel a little random, to be honest... But it fits Miko's style.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Maybe Miko wants to try to personally train someone new.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Wow! That's a really accurate guess!

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Lady Yae once said, "To discover a newcomer's potential while heading in the most interesting direction should be a unique experience."

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Now, being that senior writers mostly have their own writing style and habits, a newbie might have an advantage when it comes to incorporating foreign elements into a novel.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Lady Yae is as insightful as ever! It would seem Souka really is the best candidate for the trip to Sumeru!

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Mhm, you guys are more concerned with the whereabouts of Lady Yae after all.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Unfortunately, the schedule that Lady Yae put together for us only covers a few specific days. We're free to do as we wish in our free time.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Take me, for instance. I'm thrilled just looking through the details of the Beast Tamers Tournament.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: As for what Lady Yae does during her free time... Well, that's personal. It's not something a planner like me would have the privilege of knowing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, come to think of it, Miko isn't someone who would enjoy a packed itinerary.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: You too! Good luck with your competition!
